title: SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability
abstract: arXiv:2610.14745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. translated_title: SAGE：推动2比特向量量化大语言模型走向实际可用性
translated_abstract: 极端低比特的仅权重量化是降低大语言模型部署成本的有效方法。在3比特以下，标量量化通常会遭受严重的精度损失，而向量量化（VQ）通过更具表达力的联合编码能够更好地保持精度。然而，现有的VQ方法在真实世界任务上仍表现出显著的性能退化，且有两个设计挑战尚未被充分探索：（1）保护联合编码向量内的敏感权重通道；（2）在表示组件（如方向和半径）之间分配固定的比特预算，以适应不同的权重矩阵。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SAGE（Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy）：一种用于仅权重向量量化的方法。首先，能量分层分组（ESG）将通道分组与激活加权拟合相结合，在每个子向量内对不同能量层的通道进行分组，以优先保护敏感通道……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: SAGE通过能量分层分组（ESG）和分裂自适应机制，保护联合编码中的敏感权重通道并按矩阵特性优化方向与半径的比特预算分配，从而将2比特向量量化的大语言模型推向真实任务可用的水平。
en_tdlr: SAGE introduces Energy-Stratified Grouping and split adaptation to protect sensitive weight channels and optimally allocate bit budgets between direction and radius components, pushing 2-bit vector-quantized LLMs toward real-world usability.
